tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Play a song from the loaded library. If the requested song, artist, genre, mood, era, or description is not loaded, search the configured streaming catalog and play the best result.

track.description: The song or music track to play. Can be a specific song name or a general genre.
track.title: Track

tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search the configured music catalog for a song, artist, genre, mood, era, or description and immediately play the best matching result.

input_schema.description: Parameters for finding and playing music from the streaming catalog.

query.description: A song, artist, genre, mood, era, or natural-language description of the music to find and play.
query.title: Query

input_schema.title: SearchMusicParams

tools.name: set_eye_color
tools.description: Change the color of DJ R3X's LED eyes

color.description: The color for the eyes. Can be a basic color name like 'red', 'blue', 'green', etc.
color.title: Color

pattern.description: Optional LED pattern to display. Defaults to 'solid' if not specified.
pattern.title: Pattern

intensity.description: Brightness level from 0.0 to 1.0. Defaults to 1.0 if not specified.
intensity.title: Intensity

tools.name: analyze_scene
tools.description: Capture and analyze what the camera sees right now using vision AI. Use this when the user asks 'what do you see?', 'look at this', 'what is this?', or refers to their physical environment.

input_schema.description: Parameters for analyzing what the camera sees.

question.description: The specific question to ask about the camera image. Examples: 'What do you see?', 'What is this object?', 'Read the text on this', 'Who is in the room?'
question.title: Question

input_schema.title: AnalyzeSceneParams

perform_show.name: perform_show
perform_show.description: Perform one of your show routines - a choreographed piece with motion, lights and sound. Use it when someone asks for your intro, a routine or a big moment. Keep speaking normally; the routine runs alongside your words.

input_schema.description: Parameters for running a show routine (a show/sequences/*.json file).

id.description: The routine id, exactly as listed under <routines> in the system prompt.
id.title: Id

input_schema.title: PerformShowParams
